newsitem.title: BULGARIA: NO DEALS ON BULGARIA STOCK MARKET, RABSI FLAT.
newsitem.headline: NO DEALS ON BULGARIA STOCK MARKET, RABSI FLAT.

text.p: The RABSI (Reuter All Bulgaria Stock Index) was unchanged from Thursday's 41.14 points as there were no deals in corporate stocks on local bourses for a third day in a row, brokers said.

United Bulgarian Bank shares were offered at par of 1,000 levs on the Bulgarian Stock Exchange (BSE) but there were no bidders. Hebros Commercial Bank shares were also offered there at 800 levs, below the par of 1,000 but no bids werre received.

Varna Grand Hotel stocks were bid at 85 levs on the BSE but no one offered, traders said. Balkanbank shares were also sought there at 700 levs against the par of 1,700 but there were no shares on offer.
There were no offers or demand for corporate stocks on the Sofia Stock Exchange today and no repo deals in treasury paper either.
